Why a duplicated file rather than one repo importing the other: they deploy
separately and neither can build against the other's source. The failure
this prevents is quiet and one-directional — the editor offers a category
the server's enum does not accept, and every report of that kind 400s while
the reporter is told nothing useful. That is the class of bug that is
invisible until the day it matters.
